description: Packets and Timing timing vectors (spec 09 §14 Trickle, DAO, duty cycle, airtime, CSMA, time sync, SFN, TDMA). Python oracle lichen.timing.

vectors.name: trickle_constants
vectors.description: 14.1 Trickle Imin=4s, Imax=17min (exact 1_024_000ms = 4000*2^8), k=10.

vectors.name: trickle_interval_start
vectors.description: Trickle first interval: start 0, transmit at half (Imin/2) with rng=0.0, interval_end=4000.

vectors.name: trickle_heard_consistent
vectors.description: After 1 heard consistent, counter=1, should_transmit true (k=10).

vectors.name: trickle_suppressed_at_k
vectors.description: After >=k heard consistent, should_transmit false (suppressed).

vectors.name: trickle_expire_double
vectors.description: After expire, interval doubles to 8000 (capped at 1_024_000).

vectors.name: dao_retry_delays
vectors.description: 14.2 DAO retry exponential backoff 4,8,16s.

vectors.name: dao_sequence_validation
vectors.description: DAO Origin Sequence: starts above zero, monotonically increasing, must not wrap at 0xffffffffffffffff.

vectors.name: data_traffic_intervals
vectors.description: 14.3 Periodic telemetry 5-60min, heartbeat 30min.

vectors.name: duty_cycle_eu868_10pct
vectors.description: 14.4 EU 868 10% duty cycle, SF9 60B ~200ms => 1800 packets/hour, comfortable 100-300.

vectors.name: duty_cycle_usage_examples
vectors.description: Duty cycle usage percent for various airtime sums in 1-hour window.

vectors.name: airtime_payload_17
vectors.description: Airtime for payload 17B at SF10/125kHz (sim default).

vectors.name: airtime_payload_22
vectors.description: Airtime for payload 22B at SF10/125kHz (sim default).

vectors.name: airtime_payload_60
vectors.description: Airtime for payload 60B at SF10/125kHz (sim default).

vectors.name: airtime_payload_77
vectors.description: Airtime for payload 77B at SF10/125kHz (sim default).

vectors.name: airtime_payload_82
vectors.description: Airtime for payload 82B at SF10/125kHz (sim default).

vectors.name: airtime_payload_88
vectors.description: Airtime for payload 88B at SF10/125kHz (sim default).

vectors.name: airtime_payload_127
vectors.description: Airtime for payload 127B at SF10/125kHz (sim default).

vectors.name: airtime_sf9_60b
vectors.description: Airtime for 60B at SF9/125kHz (spec example ~200ms).

vectors.name: csma_parameters
vectors.description: 14.5 CSMA CAD 3 symbols, backoff 10ms, max 5 (CW 31), retry 3.

vectors.name: csma_backoff_slots
vectors.description: CSMA slots: CW=0 for exp 0, CW=31 for exp 5, deterministic rng mapping.

vectors.name: csma_retry_exhaustion
vectors.description: CSMA retry exhaustion after 3 retries => 4th returns retry_exhausted.

vectors.name: time_sync_epoch_floor
vectors.description: Effective epoch floor = max(firmware_build_epoch, board_provision_epoch_if_valid).

vectors.name: time_sync_stratum
vectors.description: Time stratum 0..4 table and source class mapping.

vectors.name: dio_time_option
vectors.description: DIO Time Option Type TBD 8 bytes: Type(1)+Len(1)+Stratum(1)+Reserved(1)+Timestamp(4).

vectors.name: time_adoption
vectors.description: Time adoption: higher stratum MAY adopt, lower MUST NOT, below floor MUST reject.

vectors.name: sfn_delta_wrap
vectors.description: SFN delta unsigned 32-bit: (0 - 0xFFFFFFFF) mod 2^32 = 1.

vectors.name: sfn_slot_assignment
vectors.description: Slot = (hash_32(eui64)+sfn) mod num_slots per spec 14.7.

vectors.name: density_startup_delay
vectors.description: Initial delay = min(300, nodes_heard*5); LISTEN 30-60s.

vectors.name: desync_fsm_wrap_invalid
vectors.description: SYNCED + SFN wrap invalid time => DESYNCED.

vectors.name: desync_fsm_recovering
vectors.description: DESYNCED + valid beacon => RECOVERING (needs 3 consecutive).

vectors.name: desync_fsm_recovered
vectors.description: RECOVERING + 3rd consecutive valid => SYNCED.

vectors.name: tdma_slot_constants
vectors.description: 14.8 Superframe guard 50ms (alt 100ms per table), slot 250ms, beacon timeout 3x superframe.
